tinfoil-suit.name: Tinfoil suit
tinfoil-suit.description: A crinkling silver suit, folded with restaurant precision.

railgun-upgrade.name: Weaponry upgrade kit
railgun-upgrade.description: Increases the fire rate of your railgun and Akimbos by 10% while owned.

combat-boots.name: Combat boots
combat-boots.description: Tall black leather boots with chrome buckles, steel toe caps, and heavy soles. Block 2 damage from each incoming combat hit.

party-boots.name: Party Boots
party-boots.description: Matilda’s tall rainbow boots, with platform soles and rows of metal studs.

eames-chair.name: Eames Chair
eames-chair.description: A walnut lounge chair with dark leather cushions from the Goblin Furniture Factory.

bertoia-chair.name: Bertoia Chair
bertoia-chair.description: A wire-frame chair from the Goblin Furniture Factory.

marshmallow-sofa.name: Marshmallow Sofa
marshmallow-sofa.description: Eighteen red upholstered discs on a slim tubular steel frame.

ovalia-chair.name: Ovalia Chair
ovalia-chair.description: A tall fiberglass egg with beige upholstery and an aluminum pedestal.

ball-chair.name: Ball chair
ball-chair.description: A sculptural white sphere with red upholstery and a chrome pedestal. Choose Ball chair from the Sit menu to settle inside.

rolling-pin.name: Metal rolling pin
rolling-pin.description: A stainless-steel rolling pin from Cotogna, with a solid barrel and worn wooden handles.

crowbar.name: Crowbar
crowbar.description: A steel crowbar with a red shaft and a forged hook.

new-year-rocket.name: New Year’s rocket
new-year-rocket.description: An oversized decorative rocket. Light it for ten seconds, once a minute. Press Space while it burns to hop about a character-height into the air.

uni.name: Uni
uni.description: Fresh sea urchin roe. Rich Table buys it for 40 coins.

sand-bucket.name: Bucket of sand
sand-bucket.description: A bucket filled with ordinary sand.

iron-armor.name: Iron torso armor
iron-armor.description: A dark gray iron breastplate and pauldrons.

iron-armor-legs.name: Iron leg armor
iron-armor-legs.description: Articulated iron plates that cover the thighs, knees, and shins.

gold-trimmed-iron-armor.name: Gold-trimmed iron armor
gold-trimmed-iron-armor.description: A dark iron breastplate edged with polished gold.

armor-trimming-kit.name: Armor trimming kit
armor-trimming-kit.description: Apply it to a suit of iron armor to add gold trim.

bind-tablet.name: Bind Tablet
bind-tablet.description: Binds nearby PvP opponents for ten seconds. Breaking it deals 10 damage to you.

recoil-amulet.name: Recoil Amulet
recoil-amulet.description: Returns one fifth of damage taken to the attacker.

missile-launcher.name: Missile Launcher
missile-launcher.description: A heavy shoulder launcher built in the Berkeley lab. Uses one missile per shot.

clock-amulet.name: Clock amulet
clock-amulet.description: A tiny clock on a chain. It keeps its own appointments.

backpack.name: Hiking backpack
backpack.description: A sturdy hiking pack with room for twenty sandwiches.

bison-hide.name: Bison hide
bison-hide.description: A heavy, shaggy hide. Yohji could make something remarkable from this.

bear-pelt.name: Bear pelt
bear-pelt.description: Thick, dark Tahoe fur. The decorative robe clothier buys it for trim.

fox-pelt.name: Fox pelt
fox-pelt.description: Russet Tahoe fur with a white underside. The decorative robe clothier buys it for trim.

fighter-yard-pass.name: Fighter Yard pass
fighter-yard-pass.description: A signed waiver and receipt for 10 coins, recorded by Tyler at the Fighter Yard.

goblin-phone.name: Goblin Phone
goblin-phone.description: A clay brick. The industrialist says it makes a good notepad.

decorative-robe-top.name: Decorative robe top
decorative-robe-top.description: A pink long-sleeved robe top with rainbow trim.

cashmere-turtleneck.name: Cream cashmere turtleneck
cashmere-turtleneck.description: A soft cream cashmere sweater with a thick, folded ribbed collar.

goose-corp-shirt.name: Goose Corp T-shirt
goose-corp-shirt.description: A charcoal T-shirt with a white goose logo on the chest.

goose-costume.name: Goose Costume
goose-costume.description: A padded white goose costume with an orange bill.

decorative-robe-bottom.name: Decorative robe bottom
decorative-robe-bottom.description: A pink robe skirt with a rainbow hem.

black-cloak-top.name: Black cloak top
black-cloak-top.description: An oversized black top with dropped shoulders, generous sleeves and a long, loose hem.

black-cloak-bottom.name: Black cloak bottom
black-cloak-bottom.description: A sweeping black skirt. Enough fabric to consider the wind a collaborator.

downtown-tablet.name: Downtown Teleport
downtown-tablet.description: A small purple tablet. Break it to return to downtown San Francisco.

tahoe-tablet.name: Tahoe Teleport
tahoe-tablet.description: A snowy sigil in purple stone. Break it to appear beside the Tahoe gondola.

ice-top.name: Ice top
ice-top.description: A crystalline cuirass. While equipped, blocks up to 5 damage per incoming combat hit.

ice-pants.name: Ice pants
ice-pants.description: Frosted greaves. While equipped, block up to 5 damage per incoming combat hit.

sandwich.name: Sandwich
sandwich.description: A sandwich. Store it in your food bag and eat it to recover hitpoints.

peptides.name: Peptides
peptides.description: A tiny vial with a very large social network. Ray accepts these at the Freemasons’ Guild.

coins.name: Coins
coins.description: Loose coins, awaiting a less theoretical owner.

goose-membership-card.name: Goose Corp membership card
goose-membership-card.description: A very official-looking card. The fine print seems to be turning to dust.

stetson-hat.name: Stetson
stetson-hat.description: A sand-dusted cowboy hat. The shark was keeping it under its hat.

pirate-hat.name: Pirate's hat
pirate-hat.description: A salt-stained tricorn. The previous owner had an unusually flexible interpretation of navigation.

raptor.name: Velociraptor remains
raptor.description: The emergency recovery protocol is now considerably less mobile.

kraken.name: Kraken spoils
kraken.description: The spoils of an extremely unwise maritime expedition.
